title: Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio Launches "Prom Muse 2025" Contest for Springdale High School Students
text:
Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio announces "Prom Muse 2025" contest for Springdale High School students. One couple wins custom florals, a photo shoot, and social media feature. Enter by April 15 with outfit and floral inspiration photos.
Springdale, Arkansas, United States, April 9, 2025 -- Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio , a premier floral design business in Northwest Arkansas, is excited to announce the launch of its " Prom Muse 2025 " contest, exclusively for Springdale High School students in Arkansas. One standout prom couple will win a custom floral package, professional photography session, and featured spotlight across digital platforms.
"Prom is a milestone moment in a student's life, and we believe everyone deserves extraordinary florals to complement their special night," says Althea Wiles, founder of Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio. "Through Prom Muse, we're offering students the opportunity to experience custom-designed florals that perfectly match their unique style and vision."
The Prom Muse 2025 winners will receive:
A free custom corsage and boutonniere designed specifically to complement their prom attire A mini photo shoot by L A Y E R S to capture their prom look complete with custom florals Featured spotlight on Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio's website and social media platforms Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio is known for its innovative approach to prom florals, offering designs that go far beyond traditional options. Students can choose from a variety of cutting-edge styles, including:
Cascading boutonnieres that create a dramatic, flowing effect on lapels Pocket square alternatives that transform the traditional suit pocket with elegant blooms Wristlet corsages designed as wearable floral jewelry with modern bracelet bases Elegant floral brooch-style corsages that pin beautifully to gowns, creating a sophisticated accent "Today's prom florals are all about personal expression," Wiles explains. "We're seeing students move away from traditional corsages and boutonnieres toward pieces that feel more like custom accessories that enhance their overall look."
How to Enter
Students can enter the contest by completing the entry form at https://www.roseofsharon-eventflorist.com/prom-muse-2025-contest before the deadline of April 15, 2025, at 5:00 PM . Each submission must include:
A photo of the student's prom outfit inspiration A photo of their floral inspiration Additional entries can be earned by following Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio on Instagram at @roseofsharonfloral , liking the Prom Muse announcement post, and sharing it in their stories.
The winner will be announced on April 16, 2025.
The public is invited to follow Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio on Instagram at @roseofsharonfloral to see the winning couple's photo shoot and custom floral designs after prom night.
About Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio
Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio, located in the heart of Northwest Arkansas, is dedicated to transforming everyday moments and special occasions into unforgettable memories through exquisite floral arrangements. With nearly 30 years of service to the community, the studio is known for its ability to address the unique needs and desires of customers, ensuring that every bloom tells a story.
Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio specializes in a wide range of floral services, including corporate events, weddings, elopements, sympathy flowers, and day flower deliveries. Additionally, the studio offers flower subscriptions, making it easy to bring the beauty of fresh flowers into homes and businesses on a regular basis.
Committed to sustainability, Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio integrates eco-friendly practices into its designs. The studio promotes the use of locally-grown, American flowers, supporting local growers and fostering environmental sustainability. This dedication to sustainable, eco-friendly floral artistry ensures that each creation not only captivates the eye but also upholds ethical principles.
For more information, visit https://www.roseofsharon-eventflorist.com/ . Follow on Instagram at @roseofsharonfloral.
Photo used in this press release by Sydney Rasch.
About the company: Rose of Sharon Floral Design Studio creates custom floral arrangements for weddings, events, and daily deliveries throughout Northwest Arkansas with a commitment to sustainable practices and exceptional design.
